candidates.label: Five categories of signs addressed to believers, the certain and those who reason
candidates.definition: In 45:3-5: Indeed within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers; and in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain; and in the alternation of night and day and what Allah sends down from the sky of provision giving life to the earth and directing the winds are signs for a people who reason.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَفِي خَلۡقِكُمۡ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱخۡتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزۡقٖ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا وَتَصۡرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Three recipient classes matched to sign types.

candidates.label: Challenge of what post-divine statement they would believe
candidates.definition: In 45:6: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth; then in what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe?

evidence.excerpt: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتۡلُوهَا عَلَيۡكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Arrogant persistence and ridicule upon hearing divine verses
candidates.definition: In 45:8-9: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them; and when he knows anything of Our verses he takes them in ridicule; those will have a humiliating punishment.

evidence.excerpt: يَسۡمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسۡتَكۡبِرٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَاۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيۡـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًاۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Earnings and allies failing to avail against Hell
candidates.definition: In 45:10: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies, and they will have a great punishment.

evidence.excerpt: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُم مَّا كَسَبُواْ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡلِيَآءَۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Believers commanded to forgive those expecting no divine days
candidates.definition: In 45:14: Say to those who have believed that they should forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.

evidence.excerpt: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَغۡفِرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجۡزِيَ قَوۡمَۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Individual deeds returning upon the doer before the Lord
candidates.definition: In 45:15: Whoever does a good deed it is for himself and whoever does evil it is against the self; then to your Lord you will be returned.

evidence.excerpt: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Israel's endowment and division through jealous animosity after knowledge
candidates.definition: In 45:16-17: We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood and provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds, and gave them clear proofs; and they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them out of jealous animosity between themselves.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحُكۡمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِۖ فَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفُوٓاْ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِي بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Ordained way commanded against ignorant inclinations
candidates.definition: In 45:18: Then We put you on an ordained way concerning the matter; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.

evidence.excerpt: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ فَٱتَّبِعۡهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ أَهۡوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Quran as enlightenment, guidance and mercy for the certain
candidates.definition: In 45:20: This is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain in faith.

evidence.excerpt: هَٰذَا بَصَـٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Evildoers' equality assumption condemned as evil judgement
candidates.definition: In 45:21: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds, equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge.

evidence.excerpt: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَرَحُواْ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجۡعَلَهُمۡ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءٗ مَّحۡيَاهُمۡ وَمَمَاتُهُمۡۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Desire taken as deity producing sealed faculties by divine knowledge
candidates.definition: In 45:23: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his own desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil?

evidence.excerpt: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٖ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمۡعِهِۦ وَقَلۡبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَٰوَةٗ فَمَن يَهۡدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ٱللَّهِۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Materialist worldview exposed as assumption without knowledge
candidates.definition: In 45:24: And they say there is not but our worldly life, we die and live and nothing destroys us except time; and they have of that no knowledge, they are only assuming.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالُواْ مَا هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا يُهۡلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهۡرُۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Forefather-production demand answered by divine life-death-resurrection control
candidates.definition: In 45:25-26: When Our verses are recited as clear evidences their argument is only bring back our forefathers if you are truthful; say Allah causes you to live then causes you to die then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection about which there is no doubt.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱئۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحۡيِيكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Every nation kneeling before its transcribed record
candidates.definition: In 45:28-29: You will see every nation kneeling; every nation will be called to its record, today you will be recompensed for what you used to do; this Our record speaks about you in truth, indeed We were having transcribed whatever you used to do.

evidence.excerpt: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٖ جَاثِيَةٗۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٖ تُدۡعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: هَٰذَا كِتَٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسۡتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Reciprocal forgetting: abandoning the meeting earns abandonment to Fire
candidates.definition: In 45:34-35: It will be said today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire and for you there are no helpers; that is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule and worldly life deluded you, so that Day they will not be removed nor asked to appease.

evidence.excerpt: وَقِيلَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَنسَىٰكُمۡ كَمَا نَسِيتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَا وَمَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذۡتُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوٗا وَغَرَّتۡكُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡرَجُونَ مِنۡهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Closing praise and grandeur belonging exclusively to Allah
candidates.definition: In 45:36-37: Then to Allah belongs all praise, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds; and to Him belongs all grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

evidence.excerpt: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَهُ ٱلۡكِبۡرِيَآءُ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
